ev.q: The agencies reviewed illness report forms, assessed infection prevention and control (IPC) practices, and distributed a detailed survey
Outbreak of Acute Gastroenteritis Among Rafters and Backpackers in the Backcountry of Grand Canyon National Park
At least 222 rafters and backpackers became infected, probably with norovirus.
On May 24, 2022, NPS requested CDC assistance, and an investigation was initiated.
Survey responses were linked to illness report forms of previously reported illnesses to deduplicate.
